mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1.0%, the extremely accommodative monetary policy compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 258.0, it signals persistent inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 258.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3 percentage points and employment falls by more than 0.3% over the past 3 months, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 0.3pp increase and PAYEMS < 0.3% decrease in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 0.3pp increase and PAYEMS < 0.3% decrease in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, when housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 thousand units and year-over-year GDP growth (computed from GDPC1) exceeds 2.0%, the strong economic momentum leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in the industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) both rise by more than 0.3% over the past 3 months, it signals strong housing market demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 0.3% increase and HOUST > 0.3% increase in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST both rise by more than 0.3% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening regime, when the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and employment (PAYEMS) rises by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, it signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0 AND PAYEMS > 0.5% increase in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 0.5% increase in 3 months.
